import net.officefloor.plugin.variable.Val;

/**

 * matching on first and last name (see {@link Namesakes#matches}) before the new owner is
 * saved, so the count reflects the state just prior to this create.
 */
public class CountNamesakes {

        int count = 0;
        for (Owner existing : ownerRepository.findAll()) {
            if (Namesakes.matches(existing, owner.getFirstName(), owner.getLastName())) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        owner.setNamesakeCount(count);
    }
}

      properties:

          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'

        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:

          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"

The threshold (80) sits below the hard daily create limit (100), so the warning flags a busy day before the day closes to further creates.
